_comment: cloud-ci-supply-chain-audit gate policy (owned RustSec advisory scan; replaces the reverted #974 shell cargo-audit/deny). R0 pack-shaped DATA — the Rust engine is neutral. The gate matches the workspace Cargo.lock against a VENDORED, content-addressed RustSec advisory snapshot (advisory-mirror/{advisories.json,mirror-manifest.json}, produced by libs/oya-advisory-mirror-kernel from a pinned rustsec/advisory-db checkout). A locked crate is affected by an advisory iff its semver Version satisfies NO patched and NO unaffected VersionReq. Security advisories block as SCA-VULN; unmaintained advisories block as SCA-UNMAINTAINED (gated by unmaintained_policy=all). The mirror is integrity-checked (content_hash + count) to fail closed against a truncated/desynced snapshot (SCA-MIRROR-MALFORMED/SCA-MIRROR-UNDERFLOW). No shell, no network, no clock — the network/clock-bearing refresh is a separate owned reconciler (deferred Slice D). The three time-boxed ignores below moved here from the reverted #974 deny.toml [advisories].ignore; the unmaintained=all posture moved from deny.toml [advisories].unmaintained. The ignore list is SHRINK-ONLY (run the gate binary --write to drop stale entries via SCA-STALE-IGNORE); a new affected advisory must be FIXED, never auto-ignored.
_lockfile_paths_comment: The DECLARED lockfile corpus: every Cargo.lock the gate matches against the mirror. It is NOT hand-maintained in the dangerous sense — the gate DERIVES the actual corpus by walking the tree (ci-supply-chain-audit::discover_lockfiles) and asserts set equality with this array in both directions, so a lockfile added here without a declaration is SCA-LOCKFILE-UNCOVERED and a declaration whose file is gone is SCA-LOCKFILE-ABSENT. This replaced a single `lockfile_path` string, which encoded 'scan THE lockfile' while the obligation is 'scan EVERY lockfile': the ADR-0512 kernel + cloud/cloud-kernel carve-outs, and 15 further tracked lockfiles, were entirely unscanned. Deriving from the root Cargo.toml `exclude` array was REJECTED — it names 3 entries against 18 real lockfiles (it answers 'what is not a root-workspace member', not 'where is a lockfile') and is itself hand-kept; deriving from the git-tracked file set was REJECTED because it requires spawning git, which this gate's no-shell hermetic contract forbids.

ignore.reason: async-std is unmaintained; no maintained drop-in is wired yet. Time-boxed grandfather moved from the reverted #974 deny.toml.
ignore.pull_chain: transitive dependency in the workspace graph (async-std 1.13.2 in Cargo.lock)

ignore.reason: paste is unmaintained; it is a widely-used proc-macro shim with no maintained drop-in replacement. Time-boxed grandfather moved from the reverted #974 deny.toml.
proc-macro-error2 is unmaintained; pulled transitively by derive macros with no maintained drop-in yet. Time-boxed grandfather moved from the reverted #974 deny.toml.

product_contract.born_blocking: Born-blocking: matches the live Cargo.lock against the committed advisory mirror. Green today because quinn-proto is on the patched 0.11.15 and the only other live affected advisories are the three unmaintained ids in ignore[]. Any NEW affected security advisory (or a new unmaintained crate) blocks.
product_contract.pack_shaped: Neutral engine; every repo-specific is DATA in this file + the vendored mirror. A different repo adopts the gate by declaring its lockfile_paths corpus + mirror_dir and revendoring — and is told by SCA-LOCKFILE-UNCOVERED exactly which lockfiles it forgot, because the corpus is derived from that repo's tree and asserted against the declaration.
product_contract.coverage: The gate scans exactly lockfile_paths, so the declaration IS the coverage boundary. It is pinned to reality by a derived assertion (walk the tree for Cargo.lock; assert set equality) rather than by review discipline: a fourth workspace added tomorrow REDs as SCA-LOCKFILE-UNCOVERED until it is declared. The skip list for that walk (.git/.claude/buck-out/target/node_modules) lives in gate CODE, not here, so widening it is a reviewed code change and not a one-line policy edit that silences the assertion.
product_contract.hermetic: Pure Rust predicate: serde_json + toml + semver only (no rustsec/git2/libgit2, no shell, no network, no clock). Deterministic + buck2-cacheable. Mirror integrity (content_hash + count + min floor) fails closed against a vacuously-green truncated snapshot.
product_contract.remediation_doctrine: Upgrade the affected crate to a patched version, or — for an unmaintained dep with no maintained drop-in — add a time-boxed ignore[] entry with reason/pull_chain/remove_by.
